corrective_audit.native_exit_order_type_source: fills.csv odd row indices; paired by native trade row, timestamp-checked against trades.csv and joined to evaluation_trades.csv on (entry_time, exit_time, direction)
corrective_audit.complete_30m_feature_release: bar_start + 30 minutes; backward as-of with release <= entry
corrective_audit.strategy_or_holdout_scope: No trading rerun, no strategy change, no holdout access, no live orders

paired_scenario_reconciliation.note: Separate scenario ledgers are paired by entry time and side. Recorded fill cost fields do not sum to the scenario PnL difference because exits and modeled fills are path-dependent; do not treat that residual as a pure cost estimate.

features.entry_context_interpretation: prior 50-bar channel range proxy, not standalone volatility

ledger_excursions_points.interpretation: MFE/MAE are post-entry path outcomes. MAE threshold flags potential 50-point excursions; one-minute OHLC cannot establish intraminute ordering or exact stop execution.

fixed_50_point_stop_analysis.threshold_selection: No stop level or threshold was selected or changed; fixed 50-point distance is descriptive only.

features.engine: ml4t.engineer.compute_features ATR(20) plus causal Polars features

external_context.role: dated market context only; no causal claim

source.bars: 30 unique source minutes; Chicago 17:00 anchored; incomplete bars excluded
source.input_type: Dukascopy USATECH.IDX/USD BID-only index/CFD proxy; not CME NQ

verified: trade counts, PnL, fees, months, sides, exits, and source-window identities from frozen files
inference: intraday breakout horizon may interact with measured price path and 30m regime slices
hypothesis: external macro narrative may coincide with monthly trade results; no causal attribution is identified

limitations: BID-only CFD/index proxy, not CME NQ
one-minute OHLC does not resolve intraminute event order
yearly costed and zero-cost trade paths are not asserted to match row by row
conditional slices are observational and are not causal treatment effects
trade-level MFE/MAE are outcomes and are not used as causal features
no day-cluster confidence intervals were computed
historical trial ledger is incomplete for DSR
